expected_value_creation: A hardened QIF v0.2 runtime that remains executable and auditable while preventing conceptual shortcuts around applicability, extraction, culture, governance, and verifier authority.
beneficiary: Organizations using QIF with humans, AI agents, or hybrid review teams
supporting_evidence: User acceptance criteria explicitly require raw answers, extraction steps, direct quality-intent derivation, applicability decisions, evidence-backed verdicts, and governance triggers.
Existing v0.2 packages and verifier provide an executable baseline that can be extended without a new UI or external dependency.
success_criteria: npm test validates the hardened schemas and examples.
The runtime document and examples show traceability from raw answers through extraction, applicability decision, verdict, and governance trigger without claiming semantic truth.
